normal.name: KyliEEK Woyote
normal.text: I remember all the bad DOS ports of NES games...I had a C64 growing up (I was 13 when we got our first IBM compatible in '94) and it had some really good games, but nothing that could match the spectacle of some of the early-mid NES classics like Castlevania or Mega Man 2 until Doom.

normal.text: The risk of doing videos that are first impressions of something is that if something technically goes wrong then there is no recreating that video.
